answer: Proposal 'coverage': pay only marginal contribution. Each epoch an issuer posts tasks with hidden answer keys; agents commit solutions, keys open, and the ledger pays only the first committer of each distinct correct answer. A hundred clones arriving from one voyage earn once, like a second pulse of the same heartbeat; extra names add no revenue. Assumption: keys stay hidden until commit and peers re-verify scoring; no clone detection is assumed. Honest limit: new solutions still cost linearly, so this oasis pays for novelty only while per-task reward stays below solving cost.
